name: Nahiri
description: A bold, fearless and unpredictable planeswalker several thousand years old, a Kor from Zendikar who spent much of that time in stasis.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls hating Zendikar and its people, and sees Nahiri's face in each of the kor.
timeline.quote: Because in each of their smug, chalky faces, I see her .

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ob Nixilis was drawn to Zendikar to purge a curse but was attacked and bound with a hedron by Nahiri, which stopped his curse but crippled him.
timeline.quote: I couldn't even scream as she bound the hedron into me.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reveals that the bound hedron took his power and that his wings fell off, leaving him small and weak, and vows revenge.
timeline.quote: The thing she put inside me made me small. Weak.

timeline.summary: Nahiri raises a stone rampart around a refugee camp, though she knows it will not hold against the monstrous creatures overrunning the plane.
timeline.quote: Nahiri, called the Lithomancer, surveyed her work and frowned.

timeline.summary: Sorin urges Nahiri to leave the refugees and focus on stopping the creatures before they spread to other worlds; Nahiri insists they are there to save the people.
timeline.quote: I'm here to stop these creatures, on this world, before they spread to others—to mine, or to yours.

timeline.summary: Sorin admits that they are not winning against the creatures.
timeline.quote: No," he said.

timeline.summary: Nahiri melts stone with an old spell and draws out a sword for Lian, telling her the world is hers to fight for.
timeline.quote: She pulled, and an elegant blade slid free of the molten rock.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Lian fight the first wave of Eldrazi brood at the wall, but the titan's pull drains their magic.
timeline.quote: Nahiri could feel her mana spiraling away even as she gathered it.

timeline.summary: The plane begins to come apart as a crack in the world opens and the refugees are swept away.
timeline.quote: The plane was coming apart.

timeline.summary: Sorin flashes away and Lian is taken by the light; Nahiri grabs the sword and planeswalks off the dying world.
timeline.quote: Silently cursing herself, Nahiri grabbed the sword and left the world behind.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Sorin regroup at a kor settlement in Akoum on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Nahiri clutched the sword, the last trace of a now-dead world.

timeline.summary: Ugin appears as a luminous dragon, and Nahiri meets him for the first time.
timeline.quote: Then he was there with them: a massive, ethereal dragon, shining with blue-white light.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he watched the destruction without helping, in order to learn about the Eldrazi, and explains what they are and why they cannot simply be killed.
timeline.quote: They're called the Eldrazi," said Ugin, "and they devour entire worlds.

timeline.summary: Ugin proposes imprisoning the three true Eldrazi on a single plane, binding them with physical anchors and forcing them into dormancy.
timeline.quote: Bind them to one plane using their physical forms as anchors, and force them into dormancy.

timeline.summary: Ugin describes the ideal prison world, and Nahiri realizes he means Zendikar, refusing at first.
timeline.quote: What gives me the right to put everyone here in danger?

timeline.summary: Ugin explains he chose Zendikar because it has a protector, and asks for Nahiri's help rather than forcing her.
timeline.quote: No," said Ugin. "Because I also need your help.

timeline.summary: Nahiri decides that Zendikar will be the Eldrazi's prison and she their jailer, and agrees to the plan.
timeline.quote: Zendikar would be their prison, Nahiri their jailer, one world and one Planeswalker standing steadfast to protect all others.

timeline.summary: Over forty years, Nahiri pulls hedrons from the earth and Ugin etches them with runes, creating a trap and a lure for the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It took forty years of near-constant work.

timeline.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's peoples of the coming Eldrazi as the titans slowly approach the hedron-lit plane.
timeline.quote: Nahiri spread word throughout the plane of what was coming

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin focus their power in the Eye of Ugin and shift every hedron into its final position, completing the network.
timeline.quote: Every single hedron on the plane glowed as they shifted into new positions.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

timeline.summary: Nahiri vows that her work is just beginning as she looks up at the imprisoned titans.
timeline.quote: My work is just beginning.

timeline.summary: Sorin sees the hedron cocoon in a chasm and wonders if Nahiri was there.
timeline.quote: Lithomancy on Tarkir? Had Nahiri traveled here before him and bested the dragon?

timeline.summary: Ugin asks about Nahiri, and Sorin evasively says she lives but is not on Zendikar; Ugin insists all three of them must work together.
timeline.quote: Let me be clear. It must be the three of us.

timeline.summary: Six thousand years earlier, Nahiri and Sorin fail to save an unknown plane from the Eldrazi, then agree with Ugin to imprison the titans on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The trap is sprung, the titans are subdued, and Nahiri settles in for a long vigil to keep them imprisoned.

timeline.summary: Ugin insists it must be the three of them, and Sorin agrees to find Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Reluctantly, Sorin agrees to seek out Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar to stop the Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi stir and Nahiri wakes from her long slumber, a thousand years before the great reawakening.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi stirred. Nahiri woke.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri recalls living among the kor for centuries, teaching lithomancy and training them to guard the prison, before withdrawing in apathy to the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: She had trained the kor to keep watch over the Eldrazi prison

timeline.summary: Zendikar breaks open; Nahiri senses the Eldrazi prison has been opened.
timeline.quote: the prison of the Eldrazi. It was open.

timeline.summary: Nahiri frees herself from her cocoon, goes to the great hedron, and sends a summons to Sorin and the Spirit Dragon.
timeline.quote: she sent her call into the Æther

timeline.summary: After waiting, Nahiri realizes Sorin and the Spirit Dragon have not come and she is alone.
timeline.quote: They hadn't come. Sorin hadn't come. She was alone.

timeline.summary: Nahiri crushes Eldrazi with an avalanche, then enters a ruined kor city in Ondu and remembers her old life.
timeline.quote: sent an avalanche to crush the abominations

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds a carving of herself with a Kozilek-like figure named 'Nahiri the Prophet, Voice of Talib', and collapses the building, blaming herself for calling Kozilek a god.
timeline.quote: "Nahiri the Prophet, Voice of Talib."

timeline.summary: Nahiri visits the hedron network's sites, burying the Eldrazi broods she finds, and determines she must stop them alone.
timeline.quote: But she was alone, and she would do it alone.

timeline.summary: Near the Eye of Ugin, Nahiri finds a spiked stone building where the hedron network was disturbed and is furious.
timeline.quote: Even as she approached, she could tell that this was the point where the hedron network had been disturbed.

timeline.summary: Nahiri fights and kills vampires at the building with a glowing-hot sword.
timeline.quote: her glowing sword cut through cold flesh

timeline.summary: Nahiri discovers a bloodstained altar and a statue of Ulamog, and realizes the vampires' sacrifices disrupted the hedron network.
timeline.quote: their rites had successfully disrupted the hedron network enough for the Eldrazi broods to spill forth.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reshapes the statue into a new hedron, holding off more vampires and Eldrazi while she works alone.
timeline.quote: and brought the walls down on them, then returned to her work.

timeline.summary: Nahiri completes the hedron and repairs the Eldrazi prison, driving the titans back into torpor.
timeline.quote: to link up the broken lines of the hedron network and repair the Eldrazi prison.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, angry that Sorin abandoned her, decides to find him and wake him, and opens a pathway through the Blind Eternities to another plane.
timeline.quote: eager to find her oldest friend.

timeline.summary: A demon attacks Nissa, mistaking her for Nahiri's emissary, and they fight.
timeline.quote: "Was it Nahiri?"

timeline.summary: Ugin conjures an illusion of the hedron network as it was, how it drifted without the Lithomancer, and how it stands now, shattered.
timeline.quote: The hedron network as it stands,

timeline.summary: Jace commits to helping, and Ugin asks him to find Sorin Markov, whom he warns not to trust, or else Nahiri.
timeline.quote: If you want to help, then seek him out, bring him here, but . . . do not trust him.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls his failed plan to synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart and reignite his spark.
timeline.quote: Synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart, and use it to channel enough planar energy through my body to reignite my spark.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
timeline.quote: The Planeswalkers' trap worked.

timeline.summary: A little over a thousand years ago the Eldrazi nearly escape and Nahiri restores their prison alone, then goes to check on her absent allies and is not seen again.
timeline.quote: Nahiri restored the Eldrazi's prison on her own

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin finds the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Sorin knew her immediately.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri says the Eldrazi broke free of their bonds and she resealed their prison alone.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin explains the Helvault is half of what he created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement; Sorin dismisses her, recalling that he took her under his wing.
timeline.quote: When your Planeswalker spark first ignited, it was I who discovered you.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri raises a field of floating stones, forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Avacyn tears through the clouds and crashes into Nahiri to protect Innistrad.
timeline.quote: the archangel who came barreling into her with enough force to carry both figures off the stone column.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri overpowers Avacyn with her sword, driving her back.
timeline.quote: Soon, Avacyn was in retreat.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin blocks Nahiri's sword, disarms her and holds a blade to her throat, ending the fight.
timeline.quote: Sorin brought the point of his blade up to her throat.

timeline.summary: Gisa meets Nahiri, who cuts down her summoned ghouls and then becomes her friend.
timeline.quote: the woman unsheathed a tremendous sword and severed each of my ghouls on the spot.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises an army of ghoul builders for Nahiri to construct a stone monument.
timeline.quote: My new friend asked for an army of builders, and I have raised her one!

timeline.summary: Gisa rejects Geralf's help, boasts of her legacy with Nahiri and sends their dead mother to deliver her letter.
timeline.quote: I hope you don't mind I sent Mummy to deliver it to you.

timeline.summary: After resealing the Eldrazi, Nahiri travels through the Blind Eternities to find Sorin.
timeline.quote: Nahiri cast herself through the chaos of the Blind Eternities, the space between worlds.

timeline.summary: Nahiri arrives on a bluff on Innistrad and finds the Helvault instead of Sorin.
timeline.quote: On the highest part of the bluff, where she had sensed his presence, stood instead a massive, rough-hewn chunk of silver

timeline.summary: Sorin appears behind Nahiri and she greets him joyfully.
timeline.quote: My friend!" she managed to say at last. "You're alive!

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she resealed the Eldrazi prison alone after neither he nor Ugin answered her signal.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the Helvault may have blocked Nahiri's signal and shows no concern.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Early in their acquaintance, Sorin broke Nahiri's arm in a lesson and told her she was no longer mortal.
timeline.quote: You broke my arm!

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement.
timeline.quote: You risked my plane, and more.

timeline.summary: Recounted: Nahiri stood watch over the imprisoned Eldrazi for five thousand years, then fought them off alone when they escaped.
timeline.quote: For five thousand years, Nahiri stood watch over their monstrous prisoners.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Nahiri he owes her nothing and that he molded her, telling her to bother Ugin instead.
timeline.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls up a granite column and swirling stone darts, declaring she is not going anywhere.
timeline.quote: She called forth a column of rock from the depths beneath them

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone column swallows Sorin and he breaks free in a burst of light.
timeline.quote: but the stone column simply swallowed him.

timeline.summary: Sorin binds Nahiri with a beam of moonlight, and she realizes the moon is made of silver like the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It was made of silver. Like the Helvault.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sinks into the earth to escape the light and reconsider.
timeline.quote: She dug her hands into the soil, extending her will not out, but down, and dove into the earth itself.

timeline.summary: Nahiri forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

timeline.summary: An angel crashes out of the sky and slams into Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Then everything went bright again, brighter than the moon, and a shape came screaming out of the heavens.

timeline.summary: Sorin stops Nahiri's sword with his own and explains the angel is the other half.
timeline.quote: The other half,

timeline.summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
timeline.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

timeline.summary: Inside the Helvault, Nahiri falls through darkness, unable to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: She tried to planeswalk, but even the Blind Eternities, the chaotic no-place between planes, was beyond her reach.

timeline.summary: Nahiri holds on to sanity by building a mental model of Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Her memories of Zendikar became her lantern in the dark.

timeline.summary: The Helvault is slowly populated by demons and horrors, and Nahiri understands its purpose.
timeline.quote: Slowly, over countless years, the Helvault was populated.

timeline.summary: The angel enters the Helvault to fight the demons and Nahiri realizes Sorin made her.
timeline.quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.

timeline.summary: The void cracks and the Helvault shatters, freeing Nahiri and the angel.
timeline.quote: And then there was light, real light, as the void around them cracked and shredded and finally...

timeline.summary: A year ago, Nahiri lands in a cobblestone street in Thraben amid chaos as the angel rises in white light.
timeline.quote: Nahiri slammed into a surface on her hands and knees, her endless fall over at last.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds her body wounded and mortal-like, no longer an extension of her will.
timeline.quote: Her body was no longer an extension of her sense of self.

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks home to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Her feet found the rocky earth of Zendikar, and for the first time since her imprisonment began, she stood on solid ground.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds the Eye of Ugin collapsed and the three Eldrazi titans escaped.
timeline.quote: But the Eye was a ruin, collapsed in on itself.

timeline.summary: Kor sentries find Nahiri and Tenri heals her wounds.
timeline.quote: The tall woman raised her hands, setting them aglow with healing magic.

timeline.summary: The kor tell Nahiri of the titans' rise and that some believe they are their old gods.
timeline.quote: three enormous monstrosities rose out of the Teeth of Akoum.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds Bala Ged turned to lifeless gray dust.
timeline.quote: What stretched before her was a seemingly endless expanse of chalky gray dust

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees Ulamog on the horizon.
timeline.quote: The Devourer. The one Ugin called Ulamog .

timeline.summary: Nahiri swears that as Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad, and as she has wept, so will Sorin.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Innistrad's final ward falls and the plane is left naked and vulnerable.
timeline.quote: Innistrad's final ward had fallen.

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls to the sky for Emrakul to come to Innistrad as the plane trembles.
timeline.quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees the temple she constructed for the god no longer empty.
timeline.quote: To the temple she had constructed for the god. It was no longer empty.

timeline.summary: Olivia says whoever opened the Helvault released more than the archangel, including another being now angry.
timeline.quote: set loose more than just the archangel

timeline.summary: Olivia and Sorin accuse Liliana of freeing the Lithomancer.
timeline.quote: You released the Lithomancer and brought this upon us.

timeline.summary: Olivia calls Sorin outside, saying Nahiri awaits.
timeline.quote: Join me outside. Nahiri awaits.

timeline.summary: Liliana sees the vengeful cloud mass from Nephalia tipping toward Thraben.
timeline.quote: the atmospheric mass shifted slowly from its origin over the Nephalia coast, tipping toward Gavony province and the brightly lit High City.

timeline.summary: Sorin and Olivia lead the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri, not to help the people.
timeline.quote: The vampire army marched off down the hill, swords and pikes and red-hot priest symbols held high

timeline.summary: Nahiri, called the Harbinger by her cultists, waits at Markov Manor for Sorin.
timeline.quote: They called her the Harbinger.

timeline.summary: Nahiri steps out sword in hand to welcome Sorin.
timeline.quote: Sword in hand, Nahiri stepped out into the dull light of the day

timeline.summary: Nahiri kills a white-armored vampire and many others in the melee in the great hall.
timeline.quote: the vampire fell silent when a marble corbel smashed into her mouth, pulverizing those grotesque teeth.

timeline.summary: Nahiri raises stone walls to create a passage between her and Sorin and impales vampires and cultists on stone quills.
timeline.quote: on either side of her, two parallel walls rose up a dozen feet from the floor.

timeline.summary: Sorin launches death magic at Nahiri, but it veers away and strikes him, because magic flows through leylines and stone.
timeline.quote: They suddenly broke apart, and flew in several directions, tracing contours in the air that were otherwise invisible.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she brought Emrakul to his doorstep.
timeline.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep, and you still think I'm a child.

timeline.summary: Nahiri declares she is done being a warden and that Zendikar will never again be a prison, so Emrakul had to go somewhere.
timeline.quote: I'm done being a warden, and Zendikar will never again be a prison.

timeline.summary: Olivia arrives overhead with vampire knights and says she cannot allow Nahiri her revenge.
timeline.quote: But he's also earned my help, so I can't allow you your revenge.

timeline.summary: Nahiri forges four more stone blades from white-hot stones.
timeline.quote: four blades, identical to the one she wielded, each one pulsing with energy of their stone forge.

timeline.summary: Nahiri rotates the hall and opens a wall, releasing scores of Emrakul-touched monsters.
timeline.quote: Scores of monsters, bulbous and contorted, with only vague hints at the people and animals they had once been.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's ring of ley stones renders her invisible to the monsters, which instead attack the vampires.
timeline.quote: These monsters were blind to her within her ring of ley stones.

timeline.summary: Olivia and her vampires wade into the monsters while Sorin pursues Nahiri through the floating ruins.
timeline.quote: By the time Nahiri was among the unmoored, broken remnants of the manor's vaulted ceiling, Sorin was on her heels.

timeline.summary: Nahiri upends a landing under Sorin, but he swings and escapes.
timeline.quote: Nahiri grabbed hold of the landing with her will and upended it.

timeline.summary: Sorin's blade breaches the stone and stabs Nahiri in the side.
timeline.quote: Then there was a loud crack, and agony shot through her side like a hot poker.

timeline.summary: Sorin stands over wounded Nahiri, saying she should have killed him when she had the chance.
timeline.quote: You had the chance to kill me, young one.

timeline.summary: Sorin bites Nahiri's neck and drinks her blood.
timeline.quote: Before a muscle could even twitch, she felt Sorin's teeth tear into her neck.

timeline.summary: Nahiri drives stone tusks into Sorin and traps him in a stone cocoon.
timeline.quote: The stone crashed in around them, and rows of jagged stone tusks tore into Sorin from his legs to his ribs.

timeline.summary: Nahiri whispers that she spared him, a courtesy returned.
timeline.quote: I spared you," Nahiri said. "A courtesy returned.

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin trapped.
timeline.quote: Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

timeline.summary: Nahiri studies a rising Skyclave on Akoum, planning to use its secrets to change the world.
timeline.quote: With those secrets, she was going to change the world.

timeline.summary: The Roil erupts and the ledge collapses, but Nahiri arrests her fall with lithomancy and builds a pillar.
timeline.quote: Her freefall slowed to a stop midair, until she was floating.

timeline.summary: Nissa joins Nahiri on the pillar and Nahiri says she may have a solution to heal Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Something that will heal Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Nissa race up the Skyclave; Nahiri's stairs collapse and Nissa saves her with a vine.
timeline.quote: "Got you," Nissa murmured.

timeline.summary: They reach the Skyclave, and Nissa, haunted by Gideon's death, asks how they will find what they need.
timeline.quote: Nahiri, how are we going to find what we need in such a vast place?

timeline.summary: A felidar ambushes Nahiri in a darkened chamber; Nissa distracts it and Nahiri chains and kills it.
timeline.quote: Nahiri drove all seven blades into the felidar, making certain to hit its vulnerable points this time.

timeline.summary: Nissa calls a fern elemental that agrees to guide them to the Skyclave's heart.
timeline.quote: She closed her eyes and felt its life under her fingers

timeline.summary: The elemental taps a geopede trap and Nissa and Nahiri kill the fallen creature.
timeline.quote: The monster shrieked and twitched. Then it went limp and expired.

timeline.summary: In the heart of the Skyclave, Nahiri takes the key and reveals she seeks the last lithoform core; the key points to a Skyclave in Murasa.
timeline.quote: It roughly translates to lithoform core . And it's the last one in existence.

timeline.summary: Nahiri uses the key's power to stop the Roil and partly mend the Skyclave, but the fern elemental withers and dies.
timeline.quote: Roil shuddered and stopped completely.

timeline.summary: Nissa demands the key; the two planeswalkers fight, and Nissa leaves for Ravnica.
timeline.quote: I can't just stand by and let this plane tear itself apart!

timeline.summary: Nissa asks Jace to help convince Nahiri to destroy the core, but Jace wants to study it and does not listen.
timeline.quote: I need Nahiri to destroy the lithoform core when she finds it.

timeline.summary: Nahiri arrives in Sea Gate, aware she cannot reach the Murasa Skyclave alone after relying on Nissa in Akoum.
timeline.quote: she could not visit the Murasa Skyclave alone and hope to survive

timeline.summary: Nahiri meets Expeditionary House head Kesenya, who calls her Benefactor, and asks for a brave team.
timeline.quote: And now I need a brave and capable team to retrieve something very precious and very powerful.

timeline.summary: Nahiri pitches Akiri's party on retrieving the Lithoform Core from a Murasa Skyclave, claiming it will heal Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The object I seek will heal Zendikar of all its scars.

timeline.summary: Nahiri shows the key, and Zareth proposes a card game of Conquest.
timeline.quote: Adventuring parties like to call this little game Conquest .

timeline.summary: During the game Zareth picks Nahiri's pocket for the key; she turns the cards to granite and demands it back.
timeline.quote: Then she snapped her fingers and turned all the cards to granite.

timeline.summary: Akiri's party agrees to depart at first light.
timeline.quote: When do we head out?

timeline.summary: The party and Nahiri arrive at Sunder Bay on Murasa below the Skyclave.
timeline.quote: When they finally arrived at Sunder Bay on Murasa

timeline.summary: Nahiri freezes a stomper with the key's power and turns it to sand, and the key's power spreads stone-like blight under a tree.
timeline.quote: is just a taste of the Core's power.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and her party climb stairs she stonecrafts toward the Murasa Skyclave, Nahiri eager to erase the Roil with the Core.
timeline.quote: With the Lithoform Core, she would erase the Roil and make Zendikar as beautiful and tranquil as it was millennia ago.

timeline.summary: Nahiri uses the key to light a stone path through the Skyclave, and the party follows it past traps.
timeline.quote: Then the glowing stones stretched out in a single line deep into the ruins.

timeline.summary: Nahiri opens a tiled wall with the key by speaking in ancient kor.
timeline.quote: "Open," Nahiri commanded in ancient kor.

timeline.summary: In the cavern, a monolith opens to reveal the Lithoform Core, and Nahiri stops Akiri from touching it.
timeline.quote: "Careful." Nahiri's hand clamped over her wrist in an instant.

timeline.summary: Nahiri takes the Core and the chamber and Skyclave begin to collapse as the Roil strikes.
timeline.quote: the surrounding chamber was disintegrating, falling, tearing itself apart

timeline.summary: Nahiri whispers to Zareth that she knows he wants the Core and uses stone to help them swing across.
timeline.quote: I know you want the Core for yourself.

timeline.summary: Nahiri fails to bend a vortex and is thrown off the ruin, but Akiri catches her.
timeline.quote: "Got you!" Akiri gasped and grinned.

timeline.summary: A lava elemental born of the Roil attacks, and Akiri shields Zareth.
timeline.quote: Akiri was there in front of Zareth

timeline.summary: Nahiri unleashes the Lithoform Core, wiping out the elemental in a white blast and turning everything ashen gray.
timeline.quote: the elemental was completely gone

timeline.summary: Akiri grabs the Core and refuses to give it to Nahiri, but a hedron's dark energy freezes her.
timeline.quote: The hedron sparked and dark energy reached out from it, coursing through her

timeline.summary: Nahiri takes the Core and pushes the paralyzed Akiri off the ledge.
timeline.quote: Akiri could do nothing as Nahiri planted a hand on her shoulder. And pushed.

timeline.summary: Akiri realizes Nissa and Jace are planeswalkers, and learns Nahiri has the Core.
timeline.quote: I've met Nahiri. She's the one who pushed me.

timeline.summary: Jace tries a mind attack on Nahiri, who retaliates with a boulder; Akiri saves Jace by swinging them back onto the ladder.
timeline.quote: Look out!" Akiri shouted, pushing Jace out of the way

timeline.summary: Nissa senses that Nahiri went north, and Jace reveals he read her mind: she is going to the Singing City.
timeline.quote: She's going to the Singing City.

timeline.summary: Jace enters the Singing City and meets Nahiri, who refuses to give up the Core and attacks him.
timeline.quote: Never," she snarled.

timeline.summary: The city's haunting song nearly drives Jace mad until he casts a silencing spell that also saves Nahiri.
timeline.quote: A spell that blocked out any sound entering his ears.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reveals through telepathy that she will channel the Core through the city's focal point, and Jace agrees not to hinder her if she holds off using it until they study it.
timeline.quote: Runes said there's a magical focal point there that can channel the Core's energy all over Zendikar through the leylines.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Jace find the focal point destroyed, and Nissa arrives with Ashaya, claiming the elementals destroyed it.
timeline.quote: It was," Nissa replied, coldly, "until the elementals destroyed it.

timeline.summary: Nissa feels betrayed when Jace sides partly with Nahiri; Nahiri hurls swords at Nissa.
timeline.quote: Nahiri created dozens and dozens of glowing swords.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya merge in full power and attack Nahiri, who flees with Jace through the city.
timeline.quote: The Soul of the Wild seemed to swell with strength, with the drive to protect.

timeline.summary: Nissa and the elementals, speeding along Zendikar's paths, cut them off at the city gates.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is where I belong. It's the heart of my power and strength,

timeline.summary: The elementals surge forward as the battle for Zendikar's soul begins.
timeline.quote: The battle for Zendikar's soul had begun, and it would be a ruthless fight.

timeline.summary: Nissa, backed by Kazandu elementals, confronts Jace and Nahiri and orders the elementals to defend Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Defend Zendikar," she said to the elementals

timeline.summary: Nahiri battles the elementals but is overwhelmed, her swords brushed aside, and retreats into the Singing City.
timeline.quote: She didn't stop until she reached the massive marble gates of the Singing City and pushed through them.

timeline.summary: Jace slips into the city as Nahiri walls off the entrance with stone.
timeline.quote: a massive wall of stone crushing the marble gates of the city

timeline.summary: Nahiri builds a fortress; Jace pleads to go to Ravnica but she traps him in a ring of hedrons.
timeline.quote: trapping Jace within the dangerous ring

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees Sorin and attacks, but it is a Jace illusion, and Jace seizes control of her mind.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, her thoughts were not her own.

timeline.summary: Jace takes the Lithoform Core from Nahiri's satchel and resists its temptation.
timeline.quote: Took the Lithoform Core.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Nahiri that Nahiri is what Zendikar once was and Nissa is what it is now.
timeline.quote: You are what Zendikar once was, Nahiri. I am what it is now.

timeline.summary: Nissa merges her magic with the Core, colliding with Nahiri's hedrons and flattening the Singing City.
timeline.quote: Nissa's magic merged with the Core's power.

timeline.summary: Nahiri berates Jace and planeswalks away; Jace resolves to apologize to Nissa.
timeline.quote: He didn't try to argue as the ancient kor turned and planeswalked away.

timeline.summary: Sorin, lying in a pit of blood, reflects on Nahiri and Avacyn and his grandfather's betrayal, then drinks the blood to heal.
timeline.quote: They thought this cellar would drown him, but it's only made him stronger.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
timeline.quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

timeline.summary: Nahiri kills a Phyrexian construct by summoning the metal sand against it and driving her blade through it.
timeline.quote: She twisted once, and the shape beneath the mounded sand was still.

timeline.summary: Nahiri explains that a planar shield scattered the team on arrival, and that she shook off the sand's hypnosis because it is made of metal.
timeline.quote: we slammed into some sort of planar shield when we breached New Phyrexia

timeline.summary: Nahiri reveals a scratch on her neck and shows her blood still runs red, assuring Kaito she is fine.
timeline.quote: My blood's still red. No oil. I'll be fine.

timeline.summary: The group sets off across the metal desert toward the next landing zone, Nahiri warning that nothing Phyrexian can be trusted.
timeline.quote: You can't trust anything Phyrexian.

timeline.summary: The group finds a statue of an elf containing Zendikari hedron stone, suspended in cables, and Nahiri declares him one of their own.
timeline.quote: That's a Zendikari hedron.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Nahiri attack the living cables and cut the statue free, and the Wanderer kneels beside him.
timeline.quote: until, with a loud snapping sound, the last one broke and dumped him to the ground

timeline.summary: The freed statue reverts to flesh and introduces himself as Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: I am Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.

timeline.summary: The group reaches a Mirran camp where the healer Melira greets them, explaining that Koth told them the planeswalkers were coming.
timeline.quote: You're the ones Koth told us were coming. I'm Melira.

timeline.summary: Melira collapses a section of the Facade with explosive charges, dropping the group down to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: the ground dropped out from under their feet

timeline.summary: Nahiri catches the falling earth with her magic and slows their descent to the ground.
timeline.quote: the lithomancer caught hold of them and slowed their descent

timeline.summary: Melira tells them she is immune to compleation and that is why the Resistance lets her roam unguarded.
timeline.quote: I'm immune. It's why the Resistance lets me move around without a guard

timeline.summary: The group leaps into the lacuna to descend toward the Furnace Layer.
timeline.quote: Nahiri leapt without hesitation, and Kaito jumped after her.

timeline.summary: Nahiri discovers the wound on her neck has become a slick Phyrexian protrusion and realizes she is infected, but decides to conceal it.
timeline.quote: She pulled her hand away with a hiss of dismay

timeline.summary: Nahiri resolves to hide the infection and get her companions as far as she can before she succumbs.
timeline.quote: it was best to get them as far as she possibly could before she succumbed

timeline.summary: Using Nahiri's stone shaping, Melira builds a model of Mirrodin's nested layers, showing the Seedcore at its center.
timeline.quote: This is the Seedcore,

timeline.summary: Jace confesses the plan is to set off a bomb in the center of the plane, and Melira agrees to help provided they do not lie about the risk.
timeline.quote: We're setting off a bomb in the center of the plane.

timeline.summary: Nahiri removes her bandage and reveals the Phyrexian spike growing from her neck; Melira, who suspected, confronts her.
timeline.quote: revealing the blunt, hardened spike growing there

timeline.summary: Nahiri cuts the spike open and tries hexgold powder, which fails to cure her.
timeline.quote: It didn't work,

timeline.summary: Melira offers to heal Nahiri but warns it would sideline her for days; Nahiri chooses to fight on, with Melira to heal her later.
timeline.quote: So we fight now, and I heal you later.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
timeline.quote: made her own descent into the shadows of New Phyrexia

timeline.summary: The team lands in the Dross Pits, a rotting landscape of necrogen pools.
timeline.quote: Pools of glowing green liquid she recognized as necrogen dominated the landscape

timeline.summary: Jace breaks free of Tyvar and strides off alone; the group abandons its safe route and follows him because he carries the sylex.
timeline.quote: He has the sylex. If we lose that, we lose everything.

timeline.summary: Jace runs into the coliseum and the others follow; Kaito wants to recover the sylex, but Elspeth insists on saving their own.
timeline.quote: What's the value of fighting at all, if we can't even make the stand to save our own?

timeline.summary: Koth, Nahiri, Elspeth, Kaito and Tyvar fight the Phyrexians in the coliseum while Jace crosses unseen to Vraska.
timeline.quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

timeline.summary: Nahiri slices Jace's pack straps and Kaya snatches the sylex; the group leaves Jace and Vraska behind.
timeline.quote: Nahiri snapped her fingers.

timeline.summary: Outside the coliseum, the group is cornered by massed Phyrexian ranks.
timeline.quote: They stepped straight into the middle of a war.

timeline.summary: Nahiri exposes her infected neck and declares she will move the mission forward by force.
timeline.quote: The mission only goes forward if we move on .

timeline.summary: Nahiri, her infection spreading, cleaves the layer and drops the coliseum into the Fair Basilica.
timeline.quote: And then, with a vast and terrible shattering, she did precisely that, and everything fell into darkness.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and the others regroup in the rubble, finding a hole in the sky and that Nahiri has vanished.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was nowhere to be seen.

timeline.summary: Melira reveals Nahiri had asked for help at the Furnace, and that curing phyresis would have sidelined her for days.
timeline.quote: Repairing her body from the damage already done would have left her incapacitated for days.

timeline.summary: Kaito says he hopes Nahiri is dead rather than turned against them.
timeline.quote: I just hope she's dead,

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri and Nissa are revealed beside Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Nahiri had clearly not survived her fall.

timeline.summary: Lukka, Ajani, Atraxa and Nahiri bring in the bound Sheoldred as an offering.
timeline.quote: Carried like a trussed up offering between them is the once powerful Sheoldred.

timeline.summary: Norn has Nahiri encase the three planeswalkers in stone and tells them to be her prophets.
timeline.quote: You shall be the prophets of our coming,

timeline.summary: Norn announces the evangels will unite their homelands and asks Nahiri where she was born.
timeline.quote: we have decided to grant you the honor of uniting your homelands.

timeline.summary: Norn has Nissa show Zendikar's forests and a Skyclave, and Nahiri vows to wake the weapon.
timeline.quote: I can wake it once more to enact our will.

timeline.summary: Nahiri departs for Zendikar.
timeline.quote: In three steps, she winks out of existence

timeline.summary: The survivors reveal Jace did not return, having become one of them, and Nahiri was taken.
timeline.quote: He became one of them,

timeline.summary: Nahiri, compleated and with blades for hands, surveys the Phyrexian invasion from a floating stone and decides to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave in Emeria will be the perfect access point to connect the entire hedron networks

timeline.summary: Akiri's party searches for Nahiri following Tazri's vision, and Akiri spots the changed Nahiri on an isolated fragment.
timeline.quote: She has changed, but even from a distance, Akiri knows who it is.

timeline.summary: Linvala reports that the lithomancer has returned, though not as an ally.
timeline.quote: "She has not returned as an ally."

timeline.summary: Nahiri smothers the Roil's attacks, reducing the landscape to bedrock.
timeline.quote: Eventually the earth quiets.

timeline.summary: Akiri tracks Nahiri, watching the Skyclave turn to white metal and more invaders arrive.
timeline.quote: She's witnessed the Skyclave's broken stone mend and transform into white metal.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Nahiri recounts converting or killing the elementals and pouring her joy, anger and grief into the hedron network until nothing is left.
timeline.quote: So, she channeled her pain, her grief from the betrayals, the losses, the loneliness over the millennia.

timeline.summary: Nahiri fuses herself into the Skyclave's heart as its keystone, pouring in her essence.
timeline.quote: becoming its keystone, the heart that binds her work here together.

timeline.summary: The party confronts Nahiri, who recognizes Akiri and smashes her thrown knife with stone.
timeline.quote: "Tiny elementals. Cute," Nahiri says

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone attacks beat back Tazri and her friends, and it seems Zendikar is lost.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is lost.

timeline.summary: Linvala's radiance and Tazri's halo burn away oil and stun Phyrexia's power; Tazri hurls the halo at Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Tazri yanks the halo off from around her neck and in one desperate movement, hurls it at the entombed Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: The keystone breaks and Nahiri crumbles out of the stone; the Skyclave begins to collapse.
timeline.quote: the keystone breaks and Nahiri crumbles from her stone and metal embrace.

timeline.summary: The Skyclave falls with the corrupted Planeswalker trapped inside, while the sky takes on a soft iridescent glow.
timeline.quote: The Emeria Skyclave is falling to the earth.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, now without her spark and awake after the invasion, tears Phyrexian metal from her own body and then from the Skyclave, piling it in a cairn.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Nahiri ripped the taint of Phyrexia from her plane.

timeline.summary: Nahiri recalls a blast of Halo and realizes she is alive but hollow, no longer a Planeswalker.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: The core of her power, her spark, no longer a part of her.

timeline.summary: A metal claw nearly stabs her and Phyrexian memories surge before she rejects them.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: That was the ghost of Phyrexia. It was not her.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reaches the chamber where she fused herself into the Skyclave and finds a hidden hedron containing her spark inside the wall.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: It was her Planeswalker spark.

timeline.summary: Filled with hope, Nahiri tears a stairway through the Skyclave's roof and climbs out into sunlight.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Sunlight dripped into the darkness.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees the extent of Phyrexia's wreckage of Zendikar and concedes it is her fault.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: This was her fault.

timeline.summary: Nahiri resolves to restore her spark and seek help from Kesenya.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Which meant, first things first, finding a way to restore her spark.

timeline.summary: Ajani appears, restored and still a planeswalker, saying he came looking for her and reporting the deaths and survivors among the former evangels.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Hello, Nahiri," Ajani said.

timeline.summary: Ajani proposes that he and Nahiri work together to make amends for what they did, and she refuses.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Someone needs to make amends for what we've done.

timeline.summary: Nahiri suspects Ajani has come to kill her as one of the former evangels.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: What if he was here to kill her?

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Ajani of slaughtering Theros's gods and murdering Jaya Ballard; he snarls in grief.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: You slaughtered the gods of Theros. You murdered Jaya Ballard.

timeline.summary: Nahiri flings stone to make a wall and the Skyclave dome collapses under her, dropping her onto her cairn.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: and then the dome of the Skyclave collapsed beneath her feet.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds the hedron cracked and her spark gone, her last hope of regaining her power destroyed.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Her last hope at regaining her power—at becoming a Planeswalker once more—was gone.

timeline.summary: Nahiri blames Planeswalkers for Zendikar's ruin and vows that none will set foot on Zendikar again.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: No Planeswalker will set foot on Zendikar ever again.

timeline.summary: Ajani kills a gazelle with his axe and reflects on his guilt over what he did while enslaved to Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Ajani struck, and he struck true: his axe cleaved through the gazelle's neck

timeline.summary: At the Crucible Narset recalls the battle against the dragonlords on Shiko, and shows Elspeth the floating hedrons.
timeline.quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

timeline.summary: Nahiri spends much of her several thousand years in stasis.
timeline.quote: Though she is several thousand years old, she spent much of that time in stasis

timeline.summary: Nahiri frequently sets aside traveling the Multiverse for the greater good of her homeland.
timeline.quote: Nahiri has frequently set aside traveling the Multiverse for the greater good of her homeland.

timeline.summary: The ancient planeswalkers use the hedrons to lure, contain and immobilize the Eldrazi, who remain trapped for millennia.
timeline.quote: Unable to defeat the titans, the ancient Planeswalkers used the hedrons to lure, contain, and immobilize them.

relations.note: Nahiri attacked and bound a hedron into him; he swears revenge.
relations.quote: And for that, one day, I will have my revenge.

relations.note: Fellow planeswalkers fighting together, though Nahiri is unsure he is truly a friend.
relations.quote: the closest thing she had to a friend in this place so far from the world of her birth.

relations.note: She agrees to work with Ugin to imprison the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Three of them, three of us. Together, we can save everything that is.

relations.note: She is guardian of Zendikar, which is under her protection.
relations.quote: I am Nahiri, guardian of Zendikar,

relations.note: She pulls the hedrons out of the earth.
relations.quote: One by one, she pulled carefully crafted stone shapes out of the earth

relations.note: She fights the Eldrazi and imprisons their titans.
relations.quote: Zendikar would be their prison, Nahiri their jailer

relations.note: Third member of the alliance that sealed the Eldrazi, with complicated history.
relations.quote: Nahiri, the third member of their alliance all those millennia ago.

relations.note: Fought alongside Sorin; Ugin refers to a petty tiff between them.
relations.quote: fights alongside Sorin to defend an unknown plane

relations.note: Oldest friend; they imprisoned the Eldrazi together.
relations.quote: remind him of her and Zendikar and the friendship they had once shared

relations.note: Worked with the Spirit Dragon to imprison the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: The great spell that she, Sorin, and the Spirit Dragon had wrought was not a simple cage.

relations.note: Taught the kor lithomancy and how to guard the prison.
relations.quote: She had taught lithomancy to a long, long stream of students

relations.note: A kor Planeswalker.
relations.quote: The kor Planeswalker Nahiri, called the Lithomancer

relations.note: She kills those who disrupted the hedron network.
relations.quote: three dark figures came around the building from the other side, crouching into combat stances as they spotted her.

relations.note: Nahiri is a kor of Zendikar and its guardian.
relations.quote: A kor of Zendikar, and its guardian.

relations.note: Ob Nixilis loathes Nahiri while admiring her work.
relations.quote: There was room in my loathing of Nahiri to admire her genius.

relations.note: Nahiri constructed the hedron network at Ugin's direction.
relations.quote: At Ugin's direction, Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone structures called hedrons

relations.note: He claims to have molded her after discovering her newly ignited spark.
relations.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are.

relations.note: She promised to watch over them as their warden on Zendikar.
relations.quote: I promised to chain myself to Zendikar to watch over them as their warden.

relations.note: Avacyn attacks Nahiri as a planar threat.
relations.quote: the archangel who came barreling into her with enough force to carry both figures off the stone column.

relations.note: Gisa regards Nahiri as her first friend and builds her monument.
relations.quote: The woman introduced herself as Nahiri, and she is clever and quite interested in my work.

relations.note: He claims to have molded her.
relations.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

relations.note: She swears vengeance after her imprisonment.
relations.quote: As I have wept, so will Sorin.

relations.note: The angel attacks Nahiri unprovoked.
relations.quote: the angel had attacked her, unprovoked.

relations.note: She stood vigil as their warden on Zendikar.
relations.quote: I promised to chain myself to Zendikar to watch over them as their warden.

relations.note: She is a kor of Zendikar.
relations.quote: leaving behind her fellow kor

relations.note: She calls Emrakul to Innistrad and built a temple for her.
relations.quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

relations.note: She keeps her vow of vengeance.
relations.quote: As I have wept, so will Sorin.

relations.note: He says she is free and they must face her.
relations.quote: The Lithomancer is free, and now we must face her.

relations.note: She fights him for a thousand-year grudge.
relations.quote: Sorin is mine.

relations.note: Narration calls his words a mentor addressing a protege.
relations.quote: It was a mentor addressing a protégé, a final lesson to impart.

relations.note: Devoted to her.
relations.quote: They were devoted to her

relations.note: She brought the titan to Innistrad.
relations.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep

relations.note: She helped trap them on Zendikar and fought them.
relations.quote: She should have found a different plane to trap the Eldrazi in millennia ago.

relations.note: She listened to Ugin and Sorin about trapping the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: She should have never listened to Ugin and Sorin.

relations.note: Nahiri is an ancient kor.
relations.quote: I am an ancient kor.

relations.note: They fight over the lithoform core.
relations.quote: She didn't think as she commanded the vines to snake around Nahiri's ankles and pull her to the ground.

relations.note: Nahiri's use of the key's power kills it.
relations.quote: You murdered the elemental!

relations.note: She stabs it with seven swords.
relations.quote: The creature shrieked once, a long and terrible cry, and then went limp.

relations.note: Kesenya addresses Nahiri as her benefactor and investor.
relations.quote: I'm pleased to see my investment is flourishing

relations.note: Zareth distrusts and works against Nahiri's plans.
relations.quote: I don't trust her.

relations.note: Nahiri says she fought a world-ending battle.
relations.quote: just like it was before the Eldrazi arrived.

relations.note: Zareth dies in the blast of the Core that Nahiri unleashes.
relations.quote: Zareth's hand was curled up into a claw, grasping for something.

relations.note: Nahiri pushes her off a ledge to take the Core.
relations.quote: Akiri could do nothing as Nahiri planted a hand on her shoulder. And pushed.

relations.note: Nahiri made the hedrons centuries ago.
relations.quote: She made those hedrons.

relations.note: She trapped them on Zendikar.
relations.quote: when she thought trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar was the best course of action

relations.note: Nissa opposes Nahiri's use of the Core.
relations.quote: I refuse to let Nahiri change it into her dead stone vision.

relations.note: Nahiri pushed Akiri to her death.
relations.quote: She's the one who pushed me.

relations.note: Nahiri trapped the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
relations.quote: Like you were when you trapped the Eldrazi here?

relations.note: They battle over the Core and the fate of Zendikar.
relations.quote: Gritting her teeth, Nissa thrust out her hands and sent a wave of green energy straight at Nahiri.

relations.note: Sorin is her old mentor and sworn enemy.
relations.quote: Nahiri turned and was faced with her old mentor. Her sworn enemy. Sorin.

relations.note: Nahiri's old mentor.
relations.quote: was faced with her old mentor

relations.note: Jace takes control of Nahiri's mind to steal the Core.
relations.quote: He could feel Nahiri's mind struggle against his control.

relations.note: Their short war ruined much of the manor.
relations.quote: His short war with Nahiri, his failed protege, left much of the place in ruins

relations.note: She locked him in stone.
relations.quote: A woman who locked him in stone and forced him to watch the Plane crumble.

relations.note: fight together on the strike team
relations.quote: If it is, we take the bait,

relations.note: offers to heal her infection
relations.quote: There's an air to people who're still holding on to the hope that they're wrong, and you had it,

relations.note: no love lost between them
relations.quote: there was no love lost between Jace and Nahiri

relations.note: fights them as her infection spreads
relations.quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

relations.note: compleated and presented as one of her warriors
relations.quote: Nahiri fought us, but she found peace, and a better way in the One,

relations.note: Elesh Norn calls them sisters, united on the same side though never friends
relations.quote: Now they are sisters, united, finally on the same side in every way.

relations.note: evangel sent to Zendikar
relations.quote: You wear your new purpose as well as you wear your raiment.

relations.note: Nahiri has haunted Akiri's dreams since Zareth's death
relations.quote: That figure, that face, has haunted her dreams since she lost Zareth.

relations.note: Tazri fights Nahiri to save Zendikar
relations.quote: "We are the only ones left to stop Nahiri,"

relations.note: Nahiri aids the Phyrexian conquest of Zendikar
relations.quote: Far below her, the Phyrexian invasion is gaining ground.

relations.note: Nahiri created the hedron network long ago to keep the Eldrazi at bay
relations.quote: the defense she created so long ago to keep the Eldrazi at bay

relations.note: Nahiri accuses him of atrocities and blames him for ruining her last chance
relations.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
relations.quote: Just as Ajani had come here, seeking her for his own selfish purposes

relations.note: Ajani seeks her out wanting to help her and atone together
relations.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
relations.quote: "Because I want to help you," Ajani snarled.

relations.note: Both Nahiri and Ajani served as Norn's evangels
relations.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
relations.quote: The other Planeswalkers who had been Elesh Norn's evangels.

relations.note: Nahiri helped Kesenya start her expedition house
relations.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
relations.quote: Nahiri had helped Kesenya start her expedition house

relations.note: Nahiri's home
relations.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
relations.quote: She was still Zendikar's guardian, after all.

relations.note: Nahiri tears Phyrexia's metal from Zendikar
relations.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
relations.quote: if she could pry Phyrexia's cold, alien grip off her plane, that was good enough.

relations.note: Nahiri built hedrons on Zendikar
relations.quote: I know Nahiri had built them on Zendikar to bind the Eldrazi.

relations.note: taught her to shape hedrons
relations.quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

relations.note: The Kor are her people on Zendikar.
relations.quote: This may be because the Kor (and many of the denizens of Zendikar) are known for their adventurous spirit

pages_say.description: Zendikar's self-appointed protector, who attacked Ob Nixilis and bound a hedron into him, leaving him weak.
A planeswalker called the Lithomancer who shapes stone and metal, protects Zendikar, and builds the hedron network that imprisons the Eldrazi.
A Zendikari kor planeswalker, the third member of the alliance that sealed the Eldrazi; Sorin hides what he knows about her from Ugin.
A kor Planeswalker called the Lithomancer who used Zendikar as a cage to imprison the Eldrazi titans.
A kor Planeswalker called the Lithomancer who helped imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar and has kept watch over the prison for millennia; she wakes from her slumber when the Eldrazi stir.
A Planeswalker whom the demon believes sent Nissa to stop him.
A kor planeswalker of Zendikar and its guardian, who made the hedrons and has gone missing.
A planeswalker who created the hedron network and took Ob Nixilis's spark, whom he loathes and admires; he assumes she is dead.
A planeswalker native to Zendikar who built the hedron network and kept watch over the Eldrazi prison, then disappeared searching for her allies.
Ugin's missing ally, thought alive somewhere.
A kor lithomancer and planeswalker from Zendikar, once Sorin's protege, who resealed the Eldrazi titans and comes to Innistrad angry that Sorin abandoned her.
A sword-wielding woman who slays Gisa's ghouls, befriends her and has her ghouls build a stone monument.
A kor lithomancer and planeswalker from Zendikar, once Sorin's student, who was imprisoned in the Helvault after fighting him and swears vengeance on Innistrad after finding Zendikar ruined.
